status_semantics.COVERED: The passing Flutter test exercises the same runtime context and the named state or surface; this is widget/shared-component evidence only.
status_semantics.PARTIAL: A passing Flutter test covers a shared component or adjacent state in the same product area, but an exact viewport, state, value, scroll, or route condition remains unproved.
status_semantics.MISSING: No existing passing test in the inspected suite proves the row's named state in its runtime context.

evidence_boundary: No entry is native visual acceptance. Widget tests do not prove UIKit compositor optics, exact iOS device pixels, physical iPhone interaction, VPN traffic, or TestFlight delivery. Tests guarded by Platform.isIOS are recorded as widget evidence but remain unexecuted on a non-iOS host.
